3,554 likes, 26 comments - earthpix on October 21, 2026: "This canyon looks like it doesn’t belong on Earth. ⁠
⁠
Socotra, Yemen, is known for some of the most unique nature you’ll find anywhere in the world. Strange, unique trees, white limestone cliffs, turquoise water, and dry valleys all come together across the island.⁠
⁠
It’s the kind of place where every view seems completely different from the last.⁠
⁠
By: @primpaul".
